description:
## [1.6.0](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-11-02)

### ✨ New Features

* split Firefox branding into icon, logo and name patches ([8d2fcb9](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/commit/8d2fcb917301feed27a79686b4cd7625aead61d8))

patches.name: Fix home screen numbers tile
patches.description: Hides the Channels diagnostic tip that shows up as a tile of giant numbers.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Stops usage reports, retention events and analytics sessions.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro features and skips the trial prompt. Account sync and Stripe checkout still need a real purchase.

patches.name: Use Open-Meteo for weather
patches.description: Sources weather from Open-Meteo so the at-a-glance tile works without an account.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features and stops the 10-hour trial countdown.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly app name
patches.description: Renames the app to Firefox Nightly, or to a name of your own.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly icon
patches.description: Swaps the launcher icon for the Nightly one.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly in-app logo
patches.description: Swaps the logo and wordmark shown inside the app.
